responsibility: Implements Temporary Expression Replacement during out-of-SSA conversion. Working block-local after coalescing, it identifies single-use SSA definitions whose RHS expressions can safely replace their use sites without violating coalesced partition lifetimes, call-clobber boundaries, or virtual dependency kills, tracks replaceable-expression dependencies by partitions and base decl UIDs, and returns a bitmap of SSA names to substitute so RTL expansion can see larger expressions.
same_name_distinction: This file implements TER’s block-local analysis over coalesced partitions, including dependency tracking, kill handling, call/clobber checks, and construction of the bitmap of replaceable SSA expressions. The paired gcc/tree-ssa-ter.h merely declares the exported entry points for finding and dumping those replacements.
